item.description:
Laytee 0.16.0
Laytee is easier to set up and tells you what's going on.
- When a shortcut can't do anything (nothing selected, a paused app, no translation yet), a short hint beside the pointer explains why. - If Accessibility or languages are missing, ⌥⌘C opens Laytee and shows the next step. - The Laytee window shows what to do next, and its main button always does that step. - Settings now sit on a visible Options tab, with plainer labels and explanations for each permission. - Every shortcut is listed on the General tab, including ⌥⌘C. - The menu bar shows your language pair and uses clearer action names. Settings… has ⌘,.
Built and signed locally. Not notarized.
